nodes.label: Engine 1 — Zone Map
nodes.note: WHERE ARE THE WALLS. Live-validated ~95%. IMMUTABLE.

nodes.label: Engine 2 — Shape Chain
nodes.note: WHAT PATH WILL ENERGY TAKE. Live-validated ~95%. IMMUTABLE.

nodes.label: Engine 3 — Trade Setups
nodes.note: WHERE DO I SURF. ORIGINAL v5.3.3 E3 was BROKEN (18 defects). Fixed engine UNTESTED live.

nodes.label: EARTH — Liquidity & Institutional Pressure
nodes.note: The foundation. IP zones = HEAVY earth (bedrock); LSZs = standard (soil). Everything anchors to Earth.

nodes.label: FIRE — Supply & Demand
nodes.note: Firepower + direction. BoM = hottest (100% reaction if unmitigated). MoM = cooling, tends to pierce.

nodes.label: WATER — Macro Shapes
nodes.note: The visible wave forms. Gives Fire structure; without it S/D is untradeable chaos.

nodes.label: AIR — Fibonacci (the Spiderweb)
nodes.note: No intrinsic density. Becomes a STRUCTURE only when anchored to Earth points. Pierces FIRE, not Earth.

nodes.label: R3 LAW — E2 DESIGNATES, E3 OBEYS
nodes.note: E3 never overrides E1/E2; every anchor traces to an E1 zone id + E2 shape day.

nodes.label: Earth and Fire are intrinsically linked
nodes.note: Fire w/o Earth = no fuel; Earth w/o Fire = no direction. A move needs BOTH.

nodes.label: MoM zones = LADDER STEPS ONLY
nodes.note: No reversal entries at MoM, EVER. Virgin MoM = DEATH ZONE.

nodes.label: Conservation of energy — after 2 piercing moves, 1-2 days consolidation
nodes.note: The universal recovery law. Second Law of Thermodynamics applied to markets.

nodes.label: Trading speed rule — price moves at 30-50% of expected speed
nodes.note: Add +1 day to timing; today's move becomes tomorrow's.

nodes.label: RRR floor 3.0 (IRON LAW)
nodes.note: Enforced in CODE, never by the model. Executed standard 3.5; norm 4.0+; chain ceiling 15.0.

nodes.label: Price ALWAYS sweeps liquidity zone by zone, in sequence
nodes.note: It never skips a zone. Unretested zones WILL be retested.

nodes.label: Singular-candle zone construction (zero tolerance)
nodes.note: Zone = the SINGLE candle immediately before a strong directional move.

nodes.label: HONEST ABSENCE — never fabricate a level
nodes.note: SL_INVALID/TP_NULL/RRR_BELOW_FLOOR => NO EMISSION. The 90% win rate depends on what the code REFUSES to emit.

nodes.label: ZFP (geometric) = zone_height / pair_ref_range x 100
nodes.note: THE quantity E2 consumes. Narrow zone -> LOW ZFP -> HARD WALL. DXY ref 1.60 / EU 0.0200 / GU 0.0200 / AU 0.0150.

nodes.label: Failure probability (fundamental) by zone TYPE
nodes.note: Hard Wall 5-15% ... One-Touch 50-70%. Agrees with the geometric ZFP at the EXTREMES only.

nodes.label: Confluence score 0-14 (6 dimensions x2 + extreme bonus +2)
Pressure degree (EXTREME/HEAVY/MOD-HEAVY/MODERATE/LIGHT/MINIMAL)
nodes.note: 12-14 EXTREME ... 0-3 MINIMAL. Carries its OWN failure-probability column.

nodes.label: Zone reaction counter 0/1-2/3+
nodes.note: 0 virgin (strongest if BoM, DEATH if MoM) / 1-2 active / 3+ depleted = TP only.

nodes.label: LIVE DEFECT — zfp_from_degree(confluence) substituted for the geometric ZFP
nodes.note: Different quantity. Inverts E2's terminal shape at the extremes: a hard-wall Ceiling reads LIGHT/50% -> predicts BS continuation instead of RWL reversal.

nodes.label: SS — Swing Scalps
nodes.note: Range-bound oscillation. Both bounding zones ZFP<30%.

nodes.label: BS — Breakout Surge
nodes.note: Decisive break + directional surge. Failing zone ZFP>45%; 15+min confirmation.

nodes.label: PBS — Piercing BS
nodes.note: BS that pierces intermediate zones. Failing zone ZFP>70%.

nodes.label: R — Recovery
nodes.note: Always transitional. Mid-range zone ZFP 20-40%.

nodes.label: RS — Recovery Surge
nodes.note: Sharp directional retrace instead of slow consolidation.

nodes.label: WL — Whiplash
nodes.note: Spike-and-reject. The rejection is the signal, not the surge. Rejection zone ZFP<20%.

nodes.label: RWL — Reverse Whiplash
nodes.note: WL opposite the preceding BS. Most common follow-on after a BS.

nodes.label: PWL — Piercing WL
nodes.note: Pierces multiple zones before rejection.

nodes.label: PRWL — Piercing Reverse Whiplash
nodes.note: STRONGEST reversal signal in the taxonomy.

nodes.label: WLS — Whiplash Storm
nodes.note: 2-5 sessions of violent oscillation. Almost always resolves into a BS.

nodes.label: SS(DWL) — Double Whiplash
nodes.note: Two rapid whipsaws in the range; volatility precedes a breakout attempt.

nodes.label: SS -> BS -> R -> WL (HIGHEST frequency)
nodes.note: The default weekly storyline: SS builds positioning pressure, the zone fails, BS, recovery, WL at target.

nodes.label: BS -> RWL -> SS -> BS
nodes.note: Complete false-breakout cycle. The SECOND BS often succeeds.

nodes.label: WLS -> BS (VERY HIGH)
nodes.note: WLS almost always resolves into a BS; only the direction is in question.

nodes.label: TS-1 SNIPER ENTRY = the zone edge CLOSEST to approaching price
nodes.note: SHORT from supply -> bottom edge. LONG from demand -> top edge.

nodes.label: SL Ladder-Steps — 3p outside the back edge, OR 1-2p inside the next rung's close edge
nodes.note: Relevant zone keyed on pressure state: INTACT -> LQZ shield / ABSORBED -> S/D / else golden SL.

nodes.label: ONE TP per trade — regime-conditional, never partial
nodes.note: Strong zone -> near edge + 1-2p spread. Weak zone -> far edge. Law-14: TP >= 1.2 x SL.

nodes.label: Zone pressure lifecycle VIRGIN->ACTIVE-1->ACTIVE-2->DEPLETED->FORTRESS->BROKEN
nodes.note: 100% / 80% / 50% / TP-only / 95% direction flip / never again. 4th+ battle is skipped.

nodes.label: 4-Stage Freshness Gate (index i>2 skipped; any pierce = VIOLATED terminal)
3-attempt refinement loop — ENTRY FIXED, re-anchor SL/TP only
nodes.note: The entry is the hard-won insight; SL/TP are engineering.

nodes.label: Master Trade Setup = E + FLR (Avatar State)
nodes.note: P(all four elements wrong) = 0.2^4 = 0.16%. Probability INTERSECTION, not addition.

nodes.label: Stop-limit trip-wire: trigger detects, the LIMIT fires at the entry zone
nodes.note: If price never returns the limit never fills => ZERO additional risk.

nodes.label: IP zones are NEVER entries (STRUCTURAL_ENTRY_SOURCES = ORDER_BLOCK, LQZ)
nodes.note: IP = confluence/ZFP/context + SL/TP rungs only. Mirror search SKIPS source=='PILLAR'.

nodes.label: DXY — Air-Fire dominant, MASTER COMPASS
nodes.note: Directional conviction ONLY. Never arithmetically converted to pair levels (355-710 pip error class).

nodes.label: EUR/USD — Fire-Earth dominant
nodes.note: Primary swing pair. 62.4% of DXY. PA touches the S/D-liquidity overlap DIRECTLY (NO liquidity shield).

nodes.label: GBP/USD — Earth-Water dominant
nodes.note: Primary scalp pair. 'Liquidity is the only thing respected' -- S/D gets pierced. Earth LIQUIDITY SHIELDS form in front of Fire.

nodes.label: AUD/USD — Earth dominant (slow)
nodes.note: Secondary swing. Molasses: 2-4 days per HTF move. Map the ladder and surf.
